reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with our pool cleaning and maintenance services in Irving. The team did an outstanding job keeping our pool sparkling and well-maintained. I especially want to mention Ardie and Blake for their excellent service. Ardie has helped us with a few small repairs around the pool, like fixing some loose tiles and making sure our pool steps are safe. He always works professionally and keeps us informed about what needs to be done. Blake is also quick to respond whenever we have questions, and he has explained our pool settings and maintenance schedule in a way that’s easy to understand. It’s great to know we have dedicated experts like Ardie and Blake who really care about their customers and know everything about pool care.
reviews.author: haley walls

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Irving Pool Maintenance! As first-time pool owners in Irving, we didn't know much about keeping our pool clean and running right. Chris took the time to walk us through everything step by step, answering all our questions with lots of patience. It really shows that he cares about his work and the people he helps. Since we've started using their service, our pool has looked sparkling clean—better than ever before. It was a struggle in the past just to find someone reliable to help with cleaning, but now they've even helped us upgrade and install a new pump and filter. The whole process was so easy and stress-free. We highly recommend them for anyone who wants their pool to look great and stay in top shape. We are very happy customers!
reviews.author: Barbara Mullen

reviews.text: I've been a happy customer of this pool service company for quite a while now. After reaching out to several other pool service companies for quotes, I chose this one because their prices were fair and their service really stood out. While you might find slightly lower prices elsewhere, I believe you get what you pay for, especially when it comes to pool care. What impressed me most was their expertise and professionalism. Since I had never owned a pool before, Christopher took the time to explain everything I needed to know about pool maintenance in simple, easy-to-understand terms. His knowledge really shines through, and you can tell he’s been working with pools for years. Whether it’s regular cleaning, maintenance, or even more advanced repairs and renovations, Christopher has it covered. The team is also great at communication. Unlike other companies where I had to wait days for a response, Blake got back to me right away and scheduled a visit and estimate in no time. When I first moved in, my pool was in terrible shape with lots of mechanical issues, but within a week, they turned it into a sparkling, inviting place to swim—just in time for the hot Texas weather. I’m so pleased with their work that I’m even considering having them help with some upgrades to give my pool a fresh, modern look. Overall, I highly recommend this pool service team. They’re skilled, friendly, and truly care about their customers.
reviews.author: Levi Moreno

reviews.text: Irving Pool Maintenance did an amazing job on our pool. We had our plaster pool resurfaced with fiberglass a long time ago and have loved how it held up in the Texas heat. Recently, we decided to have it resurfaced again, and the team did a fantastic job. Austin was very polite, professional, and knew exactly what he was doing. The crew paid close attention to every detail and made sure everything looked perfect. Plus, they even offer pool tile cleaning, which really helps keep things looking fresh. I highly recommend their pool services!
reviews.author: Ernest Duarte

reviews.text: Irving Pool Maintenance does an amazing job! They helped keep our pool sparkling clean and always took care of regular maintenance and any parts replacements quickly. The crew, especially Chris, went above and beyond to help out and made sure everything was installed perfectly, even delivering parts when needed. I highly recommend their pool cleaning and maintenance services. If I ever need help with another pool, I’ll definitely call them again!
reviews.author: Lois12 C

reviews.text: What a fantastic experience! Just when I thought good customer service was hard to find, Blake really impressed me. I called Irving Pool Maintenance early one morning because my gas pool heater suddenly stopped working and we had a pool party planned for the next day. Blake explained that they work with a skilled technician, but he wasn’t sure if they could make it out the same day. To my surprise, Blake called back within the hour with great news—they could send someone out and usually have quick access to any parts needed for repairs. The technician arrived sooner than I expected, checked everything thoroughly, and let me know that our pool heater had a major issue and needed replacement. He left to get a new unit and returned just a couple hours later. By the end of the day, our new pool heater was installed and running perfectly, just in time for our party. Thanks to their quick and professional service, the party was a big hit! I highly recommend their team for anyone looking for fair pricing, fast responses, and excellent pool service.
reviews.author: M Huang

reviews.text: irving pool maintenance took care of our pool cleaning and maintenance, and i couldn't be happier with their service. chris and his crew always go the extra mile to keep our pool sparkling clean, even during the hot summers in irving. any time i've had a question or needed advice about pool care, chris is quick to respond and really knows his stuff. recently, we needed a repair on our pool enclosure that was a bit unusual, but they handled it within a week and did a great job. even years after they first started servicing our pool, they still treat us like valued customers. you can tell they really care about the people they help.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Irving Pool Maintenance! Christopher and his team did an outstanding job cleaning and maintaining our pool. Chris is the pool technician, and he always shows up on schedule, is reliable, friendly, and professional. The pool always looks sparkling clean after each visit. I highly recommend using their pool cleaning services.

reviews.text: we searched for pool service companies around irving and after comparing reviews, this one stood out and gave us the best price to resurface our pool, swap out the old light for a colorful new pool light, and update the ladder and filter system. right from the start, chris explained every step, kept us in the loop about the process, and made sure we understood everything from beginning to end, which we really liked. they did excellent work and always answered our questions quickly. we would definitely recommend chris and this team to anyone in irving who needs pool resurfacing or general pool care. we also went with their suggestion to clean and seal our pool deck, and it looks fantastic! very happy with the work, the friendly crew, and the professionalism shown throughout the whole project. if you need pool service in irving, reach out to this company!

reviews.text: after our pool was finished, we had some trouble with the booster pump for our pool cleaner about a year later. we reached out to irving pool maintenance to get help with the issue since it was still under warranty. they were fast and did a great job replacing the booster pump and getting everything running again. austin, blake, and ardie were very helpful through the process and now our pool cleaner works perfectly. really happy with the service and how easy they made it.
reviews.author: Ricky24 F

reviews.text: i can’t say enough good things about irving pool maintenance. from the start, chris helped us design the perfect pool for our backyard. he really listened to what we wanted and was happy to adjust the design whenever we asked. picking out the right colors wasn’t easy, but he was patient and walked us through every option. mike managed our pool project and always kept us in the loop about what to expect. he let us know ahead of time when each crew would arrive, and if anything changed with the schedule, he made sure to update us right away. if i ever had a concern, he made sure it was fixed quickly—even when i reached out late in the evening. every crew member who worked on our pool was professional and took pride in their work. they always cleaned up after themselves, which really mattered to us. everyone was friendly, knowledgeable, and confident in what they did. if you’re thinking about getting a pool, i highly recommend this team. we just had our first swim, and it was amazing!
reviews.author: Owen Branch

reviews.text: I recently had my pool resurfaced and retiled, and the experience was fantastic from start to finish. Eric was my main point of contact, and he was always attentive, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. He made sure to schedule everything around my availability, and the whole process—draining, resurfacing, tiling, and refilling—was completed in just a week! The Texas weather was perfect, so everything moved quickly and smoothly. The crew was very friendly and kept great communication throughout the project. Eric was especially responsive, letting me know what was happening every step of the way. I really appreciated how seamless and stress-free the entire process was. More recently, I had the team come out to swap my DE filter for a cartridge filter. Chris, the technician, did an excellent job. He worked efficiently and took the time to show me how to operate and clean the new filter. He also shared some helpful pool care tips and recommendations. Just like Eric and the rest of the crew, Chris was professional and knowledgeable. Overall, I highly recommend this pool cleaning and service company to anyone needing pool maintenance or upgrades in Texas. They make owning a pool easy and enjoyable!
reviews.author: Tanner Lang

reviews.text: i recently had a new pool put in by austin from irving pool maintenance, and i'm really happy with how everything turned out! from the first visit to the last bit of work, the whole team showed a lot of knowledge and professionalism. they always arrived on time, listened to what i wanted, and gave helpful tips on both pool design and keeping everything clean and running smoothly. the quality of the work is top-notch, and the pool is now the main feature of my backyard. if you’re thinking about getting a pool or need pool service, i definitely recommend this company—they went above and beyond what i expected!
reviews.author: Rachel Pennington

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Irving Pool Maintenance. My pool in Irving had several leaks, and Chris was able to find the main problem by setting up the skimmer in a way that showed exactly how low the water would go. This really helped, since I could never figure it out myself without risking damage to the pump. Chris found the main crack, took out the old tile, and put in new tile just where it was needed—instead of replacing all the edge tile like other companies suggested. After the repairs, he cleaned up the pool and made it look brand new. The whole process was smooth, and the price was much better than the other quotes I got. I’ll definitely call them again when it’s time to resurface the pool.
